The authors discuss qualitative studies by Wood-Barcalow et al. (2010) and Frisén & Holmqvist (2010), and outline their model for understanding body appreciation as a mediator between interpersonal/intrapersonal variables and outcomes such as depressive symptoms and intuitive eating. The section concludes by indicating that 'the present study' will test this model, but no empirical data, sample characteristics, or study methodology are provided in this introduction.
